description: Canonical label manifest for the GitHub-native control plane. Labels expose machine-readable queue state. A label is a derived index of Issue, PR, commit, check, and review evidence; it is never itself acceptance, approval, or Owner adoption.

reconciliation.note: Existing labels whose names appear below may be updated to match this manifest exactly. Labels not named below must not be renamed, recoloured, re-described, or deleted.

categories.description: Lifecycle position under OPERATING-MODEL-v5.md section 9. Zero or more than one state label is a fail-closed condition.
The engagement family authorized to execute the packet. Applying it launches nothing.
Whether the packet may author repository bytes.
The nature of the bounded outcome.
The PROGRAM-PLAN-v1.md stage gate the packet belongs to.
The single primary lease domain claimed for the life of the packet. Two concurrently active mutation packets may not share a domain.

labels.name: state:ready
labels.description: Definition of Ready satisfied. Not dispatched, not running.

labels.name: state:dispatched
labels.description: Packet published for manual launch. DISPATCH is not STARTED and starts no worker.

labels.name: state:active
labels.description: A worker has published STARTED evidence. Domain lease is held.

labels.name: state:result
labels.description: Worker published RESULT with exact head, changed paths, gate output, and Draft PR.

labels.name: state:review
labels.description: Non-author independent review requested or in progress at an exact head.

labels.name: state:owner-gate
labels.description: Evidence assembled and awaiting the Owner decision. Only the Owner leaves this state.

labels.name: state:blocked
labels.description: Fail-closed stop recorded with a named BLOCKED code and preserved evidence.

labels.name: state:done
labels.description: Owner-merged or Owner-adopted, verified, and cleaned up.

labels.name: state:superseded
labels.description: Replaced by a later packet. Retained unmodified as historical evidence.

labels.name: worker:opus
labels.description: Claude Code / Opus bounded terminal executor. Launched manually by the Owner only.

labels.name: worker:codex
labels.description: Codex bounded terminal executor or independent reviewer. Launched manually by the Owner only.

labels.name: worker:none
labels.description: No worker engagement is authorized for this Issue.

labels.name: mode:mutation
labels.description: Packet may author repository bytes under an exact allowlist, on one branch, in one Draft PR.

labels.name: mode:read-only
labels.description: Packet authors no repository byte and holds no file domain lease.

labels.name: kind:implementation
labels.description: Product or platform implementation against an adopted decision.

labels.name: kind:decision
labels.description: Decision preparation. Implements nothing by itself.

labels.name: kind:review
labels.description: Independent non-author review pinned to one exact head SHA.

labels.name: kind:remediation
labels.description: Bounded repair of findings from a prior review or blocked packet.

labels.name: kind:infrastructure
labels.description: Governance, control-plane, or engineering infrastructure. Not product surface.

labels.name: kind:research
labels.description: Research Gate output. Zero authority until synthesized into an adopted decision record.

labels.name: gate:control-plane
labels.description: Control-plane infrastructure ahead of the stage graph.

labels.name: gate:g0
labels.description: Stage gate G0.

labels.name: gate:g1
labels.description: Stage gate G1.

labels.name: gate:g2a
labels.description: Stage gate G2A.

labels.name: gate:g2b
labels.description: Stage gate G2B.

labels.name: gate:g2c
labels.description: Stage gate G2C.

labels.name: gate:g3
labels.description: Stage gate G3.

labels.name: gate:g4
labels.description: Stage gate G4.

labels.name: gate:g5
labels.description: Stage gate G5.

labels.name: gate:g6
labels.description: Stage gate G6.

labels.name: gate:later
labels.description: Beyond the currently planned stage graph. Not dispatchable.

labels.name: domain:governance
labels.description: Lease over governance records under governance/, excluding governance/control-plane/.

labels.name: domain:github-control-plane
labels.description: Lease over .github/, governance/control-plane/, and tools/control-plane/.

labels.name: domain:product-definition
labels.description: Lease over product definition, catalog contracts, and schemas.

labels.name: domain:visual-target
labels.description: Lease over the physically coherent professional visual target and its recipes.

labels.name: domain:asset-readiness
labels.description: Lease over media intake, rights, provenance, and asset derivatives.

labels.name: domain:platform-quality
labels.description: Lease over accessibility, performance, and cross-surface quality gates.

labels.name: domain:engineering-foundation
labels.description: Lease over dependencies, lockfile, build, and toolchain foundations.

labels.name: domain:a600-pipeline
labels.description: Lease over the deterministic A600 asset pipeline.

labels.name: domain:product-vertical
labels.description: Lease over one end-to-end product vertical surface.

labels.name: domain:release
labels.description: Lease over release integration, Preview evidence, and production verification.

labels.name: domain:reception
labels.description: Lease over the reception and graph-memory foundation.

labels.name: domain:catalog
labels.description: Lease over the model catalog and its executable geometry bindings.
